intro: Cricket is close to a national religion in Pakistan, and the country has also been a giant of hockey and squash.

chapters.title: Cricket
text: Pakistan won the Cricket World Cup in 1992 under Imran Khan, who later became prime minister, and the T20 World Cup in 2009. Matches against India are some of the most watched sporting events on the planet.

chapters.title: Hockey and squash
text: Pakistan has won three Olympic golds and four World Cups in field hockey. In squash, Jahangir Khan went unbeaten for over five years, and Jansher Khan won eight world titles.
In 2024 Arshad Nadeem won the Olympic javelin with an Olympic record, Pakistan's first individual Olympic gold.
